description:
List the search query keywords that drive clicks/impressions to a specific page URL of a property, ranked by a chosen metric with period-over-period comparison. Accepts a date range as presets (last_7_days, last_28_days, last_3_months, last_year) or as absolute dates (from/to in Y-m-d format). Sort by clicks, impressions, position, or ctr. Returns all four metrics per keyword, a page-level summary, and cursor pagination (pass the returned next_cursor to fetch the next page). position_min/position_max keep only keywords whose current-period average position falls in that range, applied regardless of sort (position is returned on every row). The optional country/device parameters are accepted and echoed in filters but not yet applied to results, so search_volume and traffic_value_eur stay on the search-volume market of the property. Pass the property ID (UUID) or URL (sc-domain:...) from list_properties, and the full page URL. Each keyword carries search_volume: Google Ads average monthly searches in the country filter if one is given, else in the search-volume market of the property; value is null unless state is ok or zero (not_fetched = not looked up yet), as_of is the month it was fetched. Each keyword also carries traffic_value_eur: an estimated equivalent ad spend, i.e. its current-period clicks priced at the Google Ads low top-of-page bid of that same country, in EUR; 0 when Google has a volume but no bid, null when it has no volume (state not ok or zero). An estimate of what the clicks would cost as ads, not revenue.

Cost: 5 credits per call.

Examples:
```json
// Keywords driving traffic to a page over the last 28 days.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","url":"https://example.com/pricing","range":"last_28_days","sortBy":"clicks"}
```

device.description: Device slice. Omit for all devices.

range.description: Date-range preset. Mutually exclusive with from/to; pass either range or both from and to.
